LanguageData.RavenResearch_IndustrialOptimizationCycl: Continuously calibrates the handoff between Raven industrial processes. Each level increases the production speed of all Raven machines.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_IndustrialAccelerationCycl: Synchronizes pumps, processing chambers, and cultivators with tighter control cycles, significantly accelerating industrial production.
LanguageData.RavenResearch_IndustrialInfiniteIteratio: Continuously iterates Raven industrial control protocols. This research has no level cap, with each level infinitely scaling industrial production speed.
